compose_preprocessing_pipeline: compose multiple lipreading preprocessing transforms into a single callable pipeline
create_rgb_to_gray_transform: create an RgbToGray transform that converts RGB video frames to grayscale
build_normalize_transform: build a Normalize transform that scales video frames by given mean and standard deviation
